title: Green Mekong River - Cai Rang Floating Market, Can Tho
location: Ninh Kieu Wharf & Cai Rang Floating Market, Can Tho
description: Collecting floating debris from the Can Tho River and raising awareness among floating-market households against dumping waste into the Mekong.
meetingPoint: Uncle Ho Statue, Ninh Kieu Wharf, Can Tho

schedule.activity: Gather at Ninh Kieu Wharf, check-in and gear distribution
Depart by boat to Cai Rang Floating Market
River and market waste collection, sorting recyclable and hazardous waste
Return to wharf, weigh the total, take group photos and wrap up
